title: Aloo keema matar
ingredients: 1 cup tomato puree or crushed tomatoes
steps: Cook onion in oil until golden. Add garlic, ginger, and spices 1 minute.
Add beef and brown. Stir in tomato and potatoes plus a splash of water.
Cover and simmer until potatoes are tender, 15–20 minutes. Add peas for the last 5.
Salt to taste. Cilantro on top. Serve with rice.
